name: Ralphs/Food4Less Grocery Distribution Center Compton CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Signalized truck entrance off S Wilmington Ave; multi-lane gated apron with marked inbound/outbound lanes, perimeter fencing on both sides, confirmed in Street View (panos u9ks4NWck1522ecgs_UfFg and IWSCxU0z7InXt1--9qD82g).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white square guard booth (~1-2 stall footprint) set in the middle of the entry lanes under a lane canopy, visible in z20 satellite and Street View. Classic staffed check-in booth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with multiple lanes and unused paved width; room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1M+ sqft multi-building DC; dock banks on multiple building faces (west face ~12, SW faces 20+, south face ~15, plus interior bays). 90 is a conservative honest estimate across all faces; band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer-storage lots: dense organized rows in the east yard (60+) and SW rows (30+); capacity well over 50, band 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate overhead count across captured imagery (east yard + SW rows + docks); ~180.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad clearly identified in imagery; flagged uncertain. Possible scale structure near gate not confirmed.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces suggest separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Lane count estimated from gate imagery (~3 in / ~2 out); approximate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of multiple large DC buildings plus office and ancillary structures (cooling tower house, fuel island) within one gated property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense industrial fabric of Compton/Rancho Dominguez, immediately south of CA-91 freeway; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; urban infill site.
